targets.expr: max by (job_id, role) ((5 * (1 - ucloud_fleet_node_fresh)) > 0 or (4 * ucloud_fleet_node_operator_drained) > 0 or (3 * ucloud_fleet_node_soft_drained) > 0 or (2 * ucloud_fleet_node_draining) > 0 or (1 - ucloud_fleet_node_admission_open{role="sandbox"}) > 0 or 0 * ucloud_fleet_node_fresh)
100 * max by (job_id, role) (ucloud_fleet_node_resources{kind="used",resource="vcpu"}) / max by (job_id, role) (ucloud_fleet_node_resources{kind="total",resource="vcpu"})
100 * max by (job_id, role) (ucloud_fleet_node_resources{kind="used",resource="memory_mb"}) / max by (job_id, role) (ucloud_fleet_node_resources{kind="total",resource="memory_mb"})
